label: confers authority on institution
definition: Legal instrument or governing document X explicitly grants authority, powers, rights, or an institutional mandate to Y.
scope_notes: Includes: an identified power or authority granted to Y; explicit rights or mandate conferred under X; historical textual allocation of authority. Excludes: ordinary transfer of physical goods or sporting contribution; mentioning institutional requirements without granting authority; general association with a legal text. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: give or grant with omitted object; under-X have with no identified power; a provision whose grant or recipient is unresolved. This labels what the supplied text asserts, not a legal determination. Generic gives does not recover an omitted legal power.

facts.reason: Constitution → Senate: Constitutional give and have paths omit the power or right granted; the membership and advice requirements alone do not identify an affirmative grant.
facts.reviewer_question: Which identified authority or right does the Constitution confer on the Senate in these rows?

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.
